final.reason: R9: Customer confirmed transaction was unauthorized.

sar.reason: Policy threshold triggered mandatory SAR filing.
sar.narrative: The investigation concerns case HHG-005, which was triggered by transaction TXN-005 with a risk score of 0.85. The customer associated with the case has a verified identity status but no account age information. The activity was observed within the institution's transaction processing environment. The transaction was flagged despite the absence of a specific flagged transaction record. Analysis revealed a single device relationship linking the current activity to a prior closed case HIST-991. The prior case HIST-991 was adjudicated as fraud and involved a card-not-present pattern, with relevance noted as a shared device profile detected. The presence of the same device profile in the current case suggests a potential reuse of fraudulent infrastructure. This connection, combined with the high risk score, makes the activity suspicious and warrants further review.

containment_steps: Place temporary security authorization hold on transaction TXN-005
Issue immediate network-level block on all linked card PANs

customer_communication.message_copy: Did you attempt a purchase of $150.00? Reply YES if this was you, or NO if you did not make this purchase.

financial_remediation: Initiate chargeback procedures for identified exposure
